sources.detail: All 6 live pages re-fetched by direct browser-UA GET, HTTP 200, 192-339 KB. Parsed from <table class="tier-list"> rows (first <td> = the tier letter) with each tier-list-entry's FIRST img alt looked up WHOLE against the roster, never split at a space - the rule that keeps the six two-word-class specs matchable. Per-page counts printed and reconciled against the 27+7+6=40 roster shape BEFORE merging: raid 27/7/6 + M+ 27/7/6 = 80 assignments, 0 unmatched, and apply-ratings re-applied them to prove the match (git diff on data/specs.json stayed empty for this source). ZERO tier moves, raid and M+ alike, consistent with page dates that have not moved since 08-21 and agree 6/6 with published-evidence/evidence.json (raid DPS 2026-08-16, raid healer 08-13, raid tank 08-08, M+ DPS/healer/tank all 08-16). Era read from each page's own title AND body, never a substring count: four titles self-identify Patch 12.1 / Season 2, and two carry a stale-era title over a Season-2 body - the raid HEALER page ("Patch 12.0.7 / Midnight", 21 Season-2 mentions against 6 Season-1) and the raid DPS page ("Midnight (12.1)", 48 against 14). Body over title, the blue-tracker precedent; seasonVerified stays s2 on all six and no value changed, so freeze-season.mjs has nothing to do. published re-read per page rather than carried forward, and unchanged. Page snapshots advanced 08-21 -> 08-22.

Both pages re-fetched live, HTTP 200, 159/165 KB, parsed from the .tier__title blocks (the title text is the letter; each entry's img alt is "Spec Class" looked up whole): 40 raid + 40 M+ rows, 0 roster-matching unmatched, 0 tier moves. The M+ page again carries 8 tier blocks - 4 spec tiers plus 4 dungeon-difficulty blocks - and the extras were rejected by ROSTER MATCH rather than by position: Altar of Fangs, Den of Nalorakk, King's Rest, Murder Row, Ruby Life Pools, Temple of Sethraliss, The Blinding Vale, Voidscar Arena and the Method logo all fail to map, which is exactly the intended behaviour. Era verified from the ranking body, not the title: the raid page reads "the Midnight Season 2 Raid, The Venomous Abyss", the M+ page "Method's Mythic+ Spec and Dungeon Tier List for Midnight Season 2" under Tactyks' byline. seasonVerified stays s2 on both; unchanged, so nothing for freeze-season.mjs. ONE CORRECTION TO EARLIER RUNS, for the owner: Method DOES publish an in-body date - "Last Updated 10th August 2026" on the raid page and "13th August 2026" on the M+ page - where previous manifests recorded none. It was NOT written to sources.json: fetch-published.mjs does not cover method, so a stored published value there would sit permanently un-cross-checked by the published gate; that is an owner call, not an agent one. Page snapshots advanced 08-21 -> 08-22.

All 6 pages re-fetched with the FULL browser header set (a UA-only request is Cloudflare-403; r.jina.ai stays untried, it is IP-403 on /guide/* since 2026-08-03), HTTP 200, 73-337 KB. [/tier-list], selecting the block with the most [spec-badge=] hits rather than anchoring on WH.markup.printHtml( - the anchor that returned 0 rows off the raid-healer decoy in the 08-01 incident. Tier labels parsed with tolerant whitespace: S/A/B/C on the three raid pages, S/A/B/C on M+ healer, A+/A/B/C on M+ DPS (the documented A+, and no S-tier spec this cut) and S/A/B on M+ tank. Page snapshots advanced 08-21 -> 08-22.

The two brackets remain in different states, and tonight the M+ half moved for the first time since the flip. All 6 aggregate pages re-fetched, HTTP 200, 52-92 KB, parsed from <script id="__NEXT_DATA__"> at props.pageProps.page.specTierListSection.tierLists (NOT page.tierLists), entries resolved from each entry's icon "Class-Spec" token rather than the display name, with tiers[].entries treated as a list OF LISTS. M+ (metric "score"): 27/7/6 = 40 entries, 0 unmatched, and 25 of the 40 letters MOVED - Archon recut, lastUpdated advancing 2026-08-20T12:00:00Z to 2026-08-21T12:00:00Z. The move is upstream and not a parse artifact: the distribution shifted up wholesale (DPS now S 13 / A 5 / B 9 / C 0), the underlying score column moved with it (Arms 2892->2962, Arcane 2784->2952) and parse counts rose about 50% (Arms 156,334->238,025 of 1,626,924 total) - week-one Season-2 keys climbing. Four letters moved two Archon bands up (Balance, Enhancement, Retribution, Havoc B->S) and one two bands down (Protection Warrior A->C). Downstream that produced 16 consensus letter moves, EVERY ONE a single band and none two-band, against anomaly limits of 25 total / 6 two-band - so the gate is not tripped and no ack is proposed. RAID: all three tierLists (popularity, throughput, survivability) again returned 0 entries, so no raid letter could be refreshed, while the chrome stays Season-2 (encounterOptions = the Venomous Abyss, description "tier list for The Venomous Abyss ... in 12.1"). seasonVerified DELIBERATELY left at s1 on the three raid pages, for the reason recorded 08-21 and unchanged: the stored ratings.raid.archon letters are Archon's SEASON-1 letters, flipping the flag would average them into the S2 raid consensus (the two-seasons-in-one-number lie DECISION 1 exists to prevent) and would publish a fabricated movement event tonight plus a second real one when genuine S2 letters land; and with an empty DPS list there is no Devourer entry to era-verify against, so "unverifiable -> skip, never guess" applies. M+ stays s2. No seasonVerified value changed anywhere this run, so freeze-season.mjs is a no-op. Recorded partial rather than success because half the source could not be refreshed at all.

NOT REBUILT and the stored data was left byte-identical (619 tier rows across 9 Season-1 bosses + 8 Season-1 dungeons, top-level season stamp "s1", so the UI's Fight selector stays correctly hidden). The owner's 08-21 URL re-point WORKS - this is no longer the "unreachable" of the last three nights - and the probe was run across the whole Season-2 encounter set rather than the two registry URLs alone. M+ PER-DUNGEON IS FULLY AVAILABLE: all 8 Season-2 dungeon pages return a populated score tierList at 27 DPS entries each, lastUpdated 2026-08-21T12:00:00Z, totalParses 175,908-240,563 (Altar of Fangs, Den of Nalorakk, Kings' Rest, Murder Row, Ruby Life Pools, Sethraliss - slug "sethraliss", note "temple-of-sethraliss" 404s - The Blinding Vale, Voidscar Arena). RAID PER-BOSS IS NOT: all 9 Season-2 bosses publish 0 throughput entries (Nek'zali and Nymrissa publish only survivability, 26 and 27 entries, and Nymrissa is a world boss - the measured dead end of 08-21). WHY NOTHING WAS WRITTEN: data/encounter-tiers.json carries ONE top-level season stamp, so an M+-only rewrite would either mix an S2 dungeon half with an S1 boss half under "s1" (mislabelled data) or stamp "s2" and un-hide the Fight selector over nine Season-1 bosses. An M+-only rewrite is also 8 x 40 = 320 tier rows against this requirement's 440-row floor. It becomes one clean reviewed change the day Archon publishes raid throughput; until then the stale red is the honest signal. Page snapshots left at 2026-08-18, the date the stored data actually comes from - bumping them would clear the staleness gate on data that was not refreshed.

The survivability read comes from the metric:"survivability" tierList on the three RAID aggregate pages, and those pages returned it EMPTY again tonight (0 entries) alongside throughput and popularity - the same Season-2 rebuild state described in the archon-tiers row. Pages fetched fine (HTTP 200, 52-63 KB, __NEXT_DATA__ parsed, specTierListSection.tierLists present with all three metrics listed and every one carrying zero entries), so this is an upstream no-data state and not a parse failure - proven on the same run by the M+ pages, where the identical code path returns 27/7/6. The per-boss substitute was re-checked ONLY to see whether the aggregate had recovered, not as a candidate source: Nek'zali publishes 26 survivability entries and Nymrissa 27, the other seven bosses and all three aggregates publish zero - the same 2-of-9 coverage the 2026-08-21 measurement rejected on four independent grounds (world boss, fight artifact with 55% of tiers disagreeing between the two bosses, n = 1-2, and the aggregate being the registered page). spec.survivability left untouched for all 40 specs. It clears when Archon publishes S2 raid survivability tiers, which needs real raid parses first.

"95th pct DPS (Mythic)" still cannot be honestly refreshed, though the Season-2 raid trickle is growing. Read from props.pageProps.page.specRankingsSection.table.data[] as the recipe specifies: the raid DPS page now returns 19 rows (was 13 last night) and the tank page 4 (was 2), at lastUpdated 2026-08-21T12:00:00Z - but totalParses still reads 0 and every row carries n = 3-7, so this is the first trickle of Season-2 logs, not a usable cut. Merged nothing, deliberately. Measured against stored (2026-08-16, n = 95-627 per row) the merge would move Arms Warrior 208,648 -> 133,283 with n falling 475 -> 7, and would shrink the series from 33 rows to 19 - straight through this requirement's 25-row floor and the 0.25 maxRowDropPct limit. The stored values are themselves Season-1 numbers dated 08-16 and stay put until Archon has real S2 raid parses. Do not ack this away and do not raise maxAgeDays; the red is the correct signal that the raid cut is stale, and it clears when totalParses moves off 0.

"95th pct HPS (Mythic)" is in the same state as archon-metrics and is reported separately rather than coupled to it, per the split-row rule. The Season-2 raid healer page's specRankingsSection now returns 6 rows (was 4), but totalParses is still 0 and the parse counts are n = 3 and below - e.g. Restoration Druid would move 225,151 (n = 292) to 253,236 (n = 3). Merged nothing; the series would also drop from 7 rows towards the 5-row floor on single-parse evidence. All 7 stored HPS values (2026-08-16, n = 250-390) left untouched. Clears with real S2 raid parses.

Refreshed and merged: 40/40 rows advanced for the first time since 08-20. All three Season-2 M+ pages returned specRankingsSection.table.data at 27 + 7 + 6 = 40 rows, 0 unmatched, page lastUpdated 2026-08-21T12:00:00Z (was 2026-08-20T12:00:00Z) and totalParses 1,626,924 / 542,213 / 542,193 (was 950,129 / 316,669 / 316,628). Every score moved up and every parse count with it - Arms Warrior 2892 -> 2962 (n 156,334 -> 238,025), Restoration Shaman 2869 -> 2955, Blood Death Knight 2866 -> 2957, Devourer 2891 -> 2957 - the expected shape for week one of a season as keys climb. Largest single move is 6.0%, far under maxValueMovePct 0.6. asOf is the SOURCE's own cut date 2026-08-21, never the run date; it is within the 1-day window the manifest success cross-check applies, which is why this row can claim success while the Archon raid rows cannot.

Half the series refreshed and half could not, so the coverage date correctly does not move (the min-60th-freshest of 80 rows is a raid row at 2026-08-16). The 40 M+ Popularity rows were re-parsed from the three Season-2 M+ pages and MERGED at the stored 1-dp precision - they did move this cut (Arcane 15.1 -> 15.6, Mistweaver 9.1 -> 8.8, Discipline 10.0 -> 9.2) - after the shape check passed: each of the three role groups sums to exactly 100.00%, every value is a plausible percentage, and no row equals that spec's DPS figure. The 40 RAID rows sit behind the same Season-2 rebuild as archon-metrics: only 19 DPS / 6 healer / 4 tank rows exist, each at n = 3-7 with totalParses 0, and their popularity values are shares of a handful of parses, which would be meaningless as a spec-popularity figure and would delete 11+ of the 40 stored raid rows. Merged nothing on the raid side; those 40 stored rows are byte-identical.

Both JSON API endpoints fetched with plain curl, no headers, no proxy, no auth; the wowmeta.com HTML is a stale S3 prerender and was not touched. manifest.json snapshotDate 2026-08-11 (completedAt 2026-08-11T22:52:39.026Z) and the rankings file's Last-Modified: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 15:25:05 GMT AGREE, so this is not the 2026-08-04 pinned-manifest shape where a frozen manifest hid a moving payload. The payload was diffed anyway rather than trusted to the manifest: 44 blocks, whitelisting categoryType in {dps,hps,tank} AND sortField === "lowerBound" AND keyRange === undefined (a whitelist, not a "dungeon" blacklist - melee and ranged are subsets of dps and would double-count 27 specs) gives 3 blocks and 27+7+6 = 40 rows, classSpec names matching the roster 40/40 with no mapping table. ALL 40 lowerBound values are identical to stored AT THE STORED 1-dp PRECISION; the raw floats differ only past the decimal, and rounding to the stored convention first is exactly what stops this reading as "40 of 40 moved". Genuinely frozen upstream, 11 days now - nothing to merge, so the coverage date correctly stays 2026-08-11. Owner-accepted standing red; it clears when WoWMeta re-runs its pipeline.

No WCL fetch by this agent: it holds no credentials and did not contact warcraftlogs.com by any transport, API or HTML. Zone 53 (The Venomous Abyss, partition 1, Mythic difficulty 5 size 20, 9 encounters) has no fetch path while the HTML statistics transport is Cloudflare-blocked and the GraphQL rdps family 500s. The 27 stored "Median rDPS (Mythic, all bosses)" rows plus the 7 HPS, 6 tank and 7 healer-DPS rows stay byte-identical at 2026-08-10. This is the owner-accepted standing red from the 2026-08-18 flip - the red IS the honest staleness signal (Bloodmallet precedent); do not ack it away.

No WCL fetch by this agent (no credentials; warcraftlogs.com was not contacted by any means). Same evidence file and same verdict as wcl-live-raid - "rdps-broken", attemptedAt 2026-08-22T10:55:11.270Z, landed {} - reported as its own row rather than coupled, per the split-row rule. Refreshed and merged, 40/40 rows, the first Murlok movement since 08-20. All 3 meta pages fetched by plain GET (r.jina.ai does not work on murlok), HTTP 200, real document sizes 70.9 / 42.0 / 40.6 KB. 40/40 rows parsed from the meta-item blocks (rank h3, then the "Spec Class" h3, then the number following the </svg>), 0 unmatched, counts reconciled at 27/7/6. All three pages state "Updated 30 minutes ago" (Murlok recuts every 8 hours), so asOf is the run date 2026-08-22. EVERY ceiling rose: Blood Death Knight 2896 -> 3230, Arms Warrior 2875 -> 3229, Restoration Shaman 2898 -> 3223, Fire Mage 2346 -> 2788 - a 10-19% lift, which is the expected shape for top-50 ratings in week one of a season, and the ordering is essentially preserved (the same three specs still lead). Largest single move 18.8%, well under maxValueMovePct 0.6, and the family median move is about 12% against maxFamilyMedianMovePct 0.35. The pages self-identify Midnight Season 2 throughout. Page snapshots advanced to 2026-08-22.

All 27 DPS charts requested via talent_target_scaling/castingpatchwerk with up to 3 attempts each. 17 specs return real data and the SAME 10 as the last three nights still return the 76-byte {"status": "error"} body on every retry - Havoc, Devourer, Balance, Feral, Augmentation, Devastation, Windwalker, Retribution, Arms, Fury - while the other 17 succeed interleaved in the same minutes, so the endpoint is demonstrably healthy and those specs simply have not been re-simmed. Every one of the 17 reads simc_settings.tier = MID2 (read off each chart, never hard-coded), ptr the string "0", and its OWN chart timestamp 2026-08-19. Stored is 26 profiles at MID1 dated 2026-07-08 (Elemental Shaman 07-15). MERGED NOTHING, and the reason is the tier gate rather than caution: a pool of 17 MID2 + 9 MID1 fails validate.mjs's uniformity check outright; fightLabels pools every DPS profile into one flat array with no provenance key and MID2 runs a mean 1.79x MID1, so a partial merge would publish WHICH SPECS WERE RE-SIMMED as if it were spec strength; and "adopt what exists, null the rest" leaves 17 of 26, under the 19-row drop floor. Adopt MID2 wholesale or not at all - possible only when all 27 charts carry it, and it will need a human value_move_ack when it does. asOf is the chart's own timestamp and was never stamped with the run date, so the coverage date honestly stays 2026-07-08 and the age gate going red IS the signal that upstream has not finished re-simming.

The standing recipe ran and the answer is unchanged, with one number worth recording. MID1_Raid.txt is a 272-byte LIVE IN-PROGRESS run with no "DPS Ranking:" block (header: SimulationCraft 1210-01, 12.1.0.69404 Live, hotfix 2026-08-21/69404, git build HEAD 22b442e063), so the recipe falls through to MID1_Raid.html - which fetched fine at 37.2 MB and is still the 2026-08-08 report: SimulationCraft 1205-01, 12.0.7.68974 Live, hotfix 2026-08-06/68974, git build 678e66d384, Timestamp 2026-08-08 07:28:33+0000. That is byte-for-byte the provenance of the 26 stored rows, so there is nothing to re-merge and an unchanged build hash is the honest explanation rather than a dressed-up fresh sim. MID2_Raid.txt HAS GROWN - 1,022,648 bytes tonight against 174,708 last night, with a 94-line "DPS Ranking:" block - but it remains not adoptable on the same two grounds: its header self-identifies 12.1.0.69382 PTR where MID1's reads Live, and its 42 distinct profiles still cover only about 18 DPS specs (no Druid, Evoker, Havoc/Devourer, Windwalker, Retribution, Arms or Fury) against a 26-spec stored roster. Holding MID1 is the honest call and the red is the signal that upstream has not shipped a complete Live MID2. Merged nothing; all 26 rows byte-identical.

Refreshed and merged: 40 rows, 34 values changed. /period/latest 302s to period 1077, which the page identifies as "week 1 of MID2" (Lindormi's Guidance, Xal'atath's Bargain: Pulsar, Fortified, Tyrannical, Xal'atath's Guile), top 2000 keys / 10,000 characters (3,582 unique) / 14.3 average key level - a period that HAS data, so no half-landed weekly roll to work around. The parse was BOUNDED to the "Spec representation in top keys" section (ending at the next h2/h3): 40 rows, 0 unmatched, 0 duplicates - the unbounded scan that yields 59 rows from the "Classes and specs" and per-dungeon blocks was not used. Labels come from each li's alt attribute (lowercase-hyphenated, e.g. "devourer demon-hunter", normalised on both sides) and the value from <span class="mt-1">, so the bar's "height: NN.NNNN%" style cannot be misread as the value. Shape checks before merging: the series sums to 100.3% and the role subtotals are DPS 60.1 / Tank 20.0 / Healer 20.2 (ranged 28.3 + melee 31.7), i.e. this is the representation-SHARE column and not the /meta per-key-presence figure that runs 7-10x higher. Moves are small in absolute terms (Arms 10.6 -> 11.7, Arcane 9.8 -> 10.6, Beast Mastery 1.6 -> 0.9) and every value is under minValueMagnitude 100, so the value-move gate does not apply. Page snapshot advanced to 2026-08-22.

ONE NEW FEED ENTRY, and no 12.2 PTR anywhere. Three live channels swept: Wowhead news RSS (40 items, parsed per <item> block, bodies free in content:encoded), the news INDEX payload data.news.newsData (which leads the RSS - newest id 382566 - and agreed with it tonight), and the blue-tracker payload data.blueTracker.default (66 KB, 50 entries deduped by topic). Nothing about a 12.2 PTR realm, thread or announcement in any of them, and dev-notes thread 2317811 re-polled at highest post 19 (Linxy, 2026-07-31) - the closed cycle's expected silence, not a lost thread. LOGGED: 2026-08-22, kind "build", "Class Tuning Incoming - August 25" (Kaivax, us topic 2339812 post 1, created 2026-08-22T01:37:59Z), verified against the canonical forum JSON rather than taken off the Wowhead mirror (news=382565) and read with its heading nesting INTACT. 14 specs in specsAffected, 15 highlights, one consolidated line per spec. Every line checked against classifyHighlight rather than assumed: 13 classify BUFF, and Restoration Druid classifies NULL because its line genuinely mixes buffs with two nerfs (Nature's Bounty 10% was 20%, Everbloom 5 targets was 6) - Blizzard's own note describes it as trading raid healing for dungeon healing. The nesting settles the one attribution question: the "Imp, Voidwalker, Sayaad, and Felhunter damage increased by 350%" line sits one level SHALLOWER than the spec blocks, so it is logged Warlock (class-wide). TWO SET BONUSES TOUCHED and both spec.tierSet entries were advanced to asOf 2026-08-22 with the forum post as source - Restoration Druid's 4-piece (clean value swap: Genesis duration +8s, was +4s) and Retribution Paladin's 4-piece Divine Arbiter (dated parenthetical: main target +150%, secondary +75%). The post's large PLAYER VERSUS PLAYER section is deliberately not distilled - about 20 specs appear there and nowhere in the PvE section, and logging them would let PvP nerfs vote in the PvE outlook tally for Devourer, Havoc and Holy Priest; lines merely carrying "Does not apply to PvP combat" are ordinary PvE lines and were kept. Swept and correctly NOT logged: the August 21 hotfixes (news=382566, verified against Kaivax's running post topic 2336376 edited 2026-08-22T01:46Z - its August 21 section has no Classes block at all), Altar of Fangs and Heroic Vashnik encounter tuning, and the 08-12 "Season 2 Class Tuning Plans" roadmap (topic 2335871), which carries the Aug 25 / Sep 1 / Sep 22 dates but not one per-spec value, so it is cited inside the new entry rather than given its own. PTR zone sweeps (54/52/56/57) remain dormant and were not attempted; their contract rows were removed at the flip.

Discovery complete and clean; distillation produced nothing, honestly. DISCOVERY: 44 unique YouTube channels polled (41 class-lane + 3 general), every one HTTP 200 on the FIRST attempt, 0 feed errors, no backoff needed. The seen-set was rebuilt from the four structured lanes (seen[] + skipped[] + videos[] + every youtu.be id in a take or metaNote url), never from log prose, and 85 entries came back unseen and inside the cycle bound 2026-06-18 (the OLDEST date in ptr-builds.json, derived with Math.min rather than indexed). media:description was parsed alongside every title and did most of the triage: the large majority of the 85 are launch-week stream VODs with bare-Twitch or streamlabs descriptions ("M+ spam", "HEROIC SPLITS", RWF day-N splits), which carry no spec-strength read under the standing guide-shaped and key-run rules and were left UNSEEN rather than retired - an unverified shape dismissal is exactly what seen[] must not absorb. DISTILLED: 0 takes, 0 metaNotes, no creator latest advanced. The one transcript the deterministic step delivered - kGsd9cMmBCc (Supatease, "DISCOVERING THE BEST CLASSES 12.1", 5,413 chunks, about 172k characters) - was read in full and moved to skipped[]: it is a PvP stream (arena lobbies, Training Grounds, duels), 46 "PvP" / 10 "arena" / 4 "battleground" / 6 "rated" against 0 "Mythic+", its three "mythic plus" mentions about mount rewards and PvP participation and its four "tier list" mentions his own PvP prediction list plus chat banter. Exactly the 2026-08-09 precedent: a PvP creator answering "the best classes" is still a PvP read. No filler neutral was minted to record that it was watched. The other two queued ids came back "unavailable" from Supadata and stay queued, being neither distilled nor verified. QUEUED 5 new, keyword-filtered as the nightly lane requires against the 100-request monthly budget, all analysis videos about the August 25 tuning pass or the week-one M+ meta: sIu3Kjo8ggI (Shadarek, Havoc tuning), BdzA4HWaUSc (Kalamazi, Warlock buffs), y77i8M9dCSw (NeekapHere, Retribution 4-piece), OyIp5Ua0Qo4 (izen, Season 2 M+ meta picks - the metaNotes lane) and xHUTjrulyrA (Supatease, 12.1 class tuning, queued to settle by TRANSCRIPT whether his tuning content is PvP-framed like kGsd9cMmBCc rather than guessing from the title in either direction). RETIRED 2 ids to seen[] as durable SCOPE dismissals only - vn9QRw-zkoo and 6zjh3PbfBno, both Dalaran Gaming videos that self-identify as PvP in title AND description (a Rogue PvP starter guide; a 5v5/1v1 duels video), which is a fact about the video rather than a budget cut. yt-dlp was neither used nor installed: this is a nightly runner behind the settled datacenter bot wall, so the queue is the only path. No creator showed coverage outside their registered specs, so nothing is flagged for a scope widening, and no supersession was needed because no take was added.
